Completed Tasks for Boilerplate Package

Source: tasks-done.md

Test Data Import Fixes (Partial)

✅ Fixed Import/Export Test Issues

  • Updated test file paths to use correct data directory structure
  • Fixed file naming conventions (e.g., methods_db.rds instead of boilerplate_methods.rds)
  • Added proper data_path parameters to all import/export function calls
  • Fixed database structure issues (removed unnecessary wrappers)
  • Corrected export path construction issues

Results: 24 out of 28 import-export tests now passing

✅ Fixed Generate Test Issues

  • Updated tests to load databases from files correctly
  • Fixed regex escaping for template pattern matching
  • Corrected database structure expectations

Results: 97 out of 100 generate tests now passing

JSON Enhancement Implementation

✅ 1. Updated Examples for CRAN Submission

  • Modified all examples to be runnable
  • Examples now use temporary directories via tempdir()
  • Initialize databases with actual data
  • Clean up after themselves
  • Run quickly (< 5 seconds)
  • Set quiet = TRUE and confirm = FALSE to avoid prompts
  • Files updated: 9 R files with working examples

✅ 2. Created Migration Example for go-bayes Lab Database

  • Created comprehensive migration script: inst/examples/json-poc/migrate_go_bayes_lab.R
  • Downloads RDS files from GitHub
  • Converts to unified JSON structure
  • Creates proper directory organization
  • Generates JSON schemas for validation
  • Includes timestamped backups

✅ 3. Implemented Unified JSON File Structure

  • Single boilerplate_unified.json file instead of multiple files
  • Includes metadata and versioning (_meta fields)
  • Supports hierarchical paths (e.g., methods.statistical.regression)
  • Maintains backward compatibility with RDS format
  • Enables better version control and collaboration

✅ 4. Designed Web Interface for JSON Data Input

  • Created modern web interface: inst/examples/json-poc/web_editor.html
  • Features:
    • Category tabs (Methods, Measures, Results, Discussion)
    • Search functionality
    • Form-based editing with validation
    • Local storage support
    • Import/export capabilities
    • Real-time JSON preview
    • Responsive design

✅ 5. Added Roxygen Documentation for JSON Functions

  • Documented all JSON support functions in R/json-support.R:
    • boilerplate_import_json()
    • boilerplate_save_json()
    • boilerplate_rds_to_json()
    • boilerplate_batch_edit_json()
    • boilerplate_standardise_measures_json()
  • Documented migration utilities in R/migration-utilities.R:
    • boilerplate_migrate_to_json()
    • validate_json_database()
    • compare_rds_json()

✅ 6. Exported JSON Functions in NAMESPACE

  • Ran devtools::document() to update NAMESPACE
  • All JSON functions are now exported and available to users
  • Generated .Rd documentation files for all functions

✅ 7. Created Comprehensive Tests for JSON Functions

  • test-json-support.R (37 tests):
    • Read/write functionality for both formats
    • Import/export operations
    • Batch editing
    • Format conversion
    • Compatibility testing
  • test-json-unified.R (28 tests):
    • Unified structure validation
    • Hierarchical path access
    • Metadata preservation
    • Web interface compatibility
    • Performance testing
  • test-migration-utilities.R (12 tests):
    • Migration workflows
    • Database comparison
    • Special character handling
    • Backup creation

Total: 77 passing tests for JSON functionality

Summary of JSON Enhancements

The boilerplate package now has full JSON support that: - ✅ Reads/writes JSON format alongside RDS - ✅ Supports unified single-file structure - ✅ Includes migration tools from RDS to JSON - ✅ Has validation against JSON schemas - ✅ Provides a web interface for editing - ✅ Maintains full backward compatibility - ✅ Is fully tested and documented - ✅ Is exported and ready for use
